issues.display_title: Issue #13: Update Availability Open/Close Indicator & Handle Portfolio Name Hidden at No Preview Image
issues.main_description_html:
2026-06-19-availability-open-close-and-portfolio-name-overlay.md

Feature 1: Service Hours → Open / Closed Indicator

Context

The "Availability" section on the photographer profile page lists all days of the week with either a time range ("09:00 – 18:00") or "Closed". The API only returns which days the photographer is available — no actual time ranges are stored. The time string is a hardcoded display value.

  • AC1: The "Availability / Service hours" section never displays any time string (09:00, 18:00, 17:00, or any HH:MM format).
  • AC2: Every available day renders a green dot (bg-green-500) followed by the text "Open" in normal foreground color.
  • AC3: Every unavailable day renders a muted gray dot (bg-muted-foreground/40) followed by the text "Closed" in muted color (text-muted-foreground/60).
  • AC4: Both code paths produce the correct output — photographers who have availability data from the API, and those who fall back to the static default list.

Feature 2: Portfolio Thumbnail — Always Show Name Overlay

Context

Portfolio items in the 360 portfolio grid (photographerPortfolio.tsx) show a gradient overlay with the item name at the bottom of the thumbnail image. When no thumbnail is available (or image fails to load), a "No preview" placeholder is shown — but the item name is not displayed in this state.

  • AC1: Portfolio items with a valid thumbnail continue to show the gradient name overlay at the bottom, unchanged.
  • AC2: Portfolio items with no thumbnail (dashed border + camera icon + "No preview") also show the gradient name overlay at the bottom of the card.
  • AC3: If an item has neither businessName nor title, no empty gradient bar is rendered.
  • AC4: The behavior is consistent across all four portfolio types: GoThru, Google Street View, Panorra, and Matterport.

Demo by Developer

2026-06-19.16-56-43.mp4

Verdict: PASSED. Read-only testing used real public data on https://360photographers.org/photographer/ekosyaepulloh; no profile, portfolio, or production data was created, changed, or deleted.

issues.display_title: Issue #50: feat: public Street View thumbnail for google-type photographer portfolio
issues.main_description_html:
## Problem Adding a photographer portfolio item of type google stores the thumbnail from the page's og:image, which for 360 photospheres is a session-signed lh3.googleusercontent.com/gpms-cs-s/... URL. The token expires, so stored thumbnails start returning 403. ## Solution New helper helpers.GetGoogleStreetViewThumbnail(value): 1. Resolves maps.app.goo.gl short links (extracted ResolveGoogleMapsShortLink, reused by GenerateGoogleMapsEmbedUrl). 2. Extracts the panorama id from the !1s<panoid>!2e<type> segment. 3. User photospheres (!2e10): mints a fresh public gpms-cs-s URL via the photometa/v1 endpoint (no auth, no API key), returned as =w900-h600-k-no. 4. Official Street View (!2e0): stable streetviewpixels-pa.googleapis.com/v1/thumbnail URL. Wired into resolveThumbnailForType (PortfolioTypeGoogle) — used by both create and update portfolio; falls back to the old og:image path for non–street-view links. ## Files - src/helpers/googleMapsEmbed.go — helper + short-link resolver - src/action/v1/portfolio/portfolioHelper.go — wiring - src/helpers/googleMapsEmbed_test.go — live test ## Testing go test -run TestGetGoogleStreetViewThumbnail_Live ./src/helpers/ — 5 real short links must resolve and serve 200 image/* publicly (no cookies): 5/5 pass. ## Known limitation Minted gpms-cs-s URLs still expire eventually (marked with ponytail: comment). If stored thumbnails 403 again: re-mint on read, or cache image bytes to our own storage at create time.

QA Review - 7 August 2026

Result

PASSED. No confirmed coding defect found in the delivered scope. The developer note was applied: only a share link opened on the intended 360 panorama is supported; place-only links are deliberately excluded because they cannot reliably identify the photographer's own 360.

Scope and real-data verification

Area Method Result Evidence
User photosphere short links Black-box live requests, no cookies/API key PASS 5/5 public Google Maps short links resolved to image thumbnails; each returned HTTP 200 with image/*.
Existing portfolio records Black-box read-only API dry-run against the running internal service PASS for panorama-bearing records Service health was HTTP 200; dry-run discovered 184 Google portfolio rows and produced fresh thumbnails for valid panorama links without writing data.
Place-only links Black-box negative test and developer-comment review PASS (expected rejection) Returned no panorama id in google maps url; this is the explicitly documented restriction, not a coding defect.
Input validation White-box unit tests PASS Valid short/full Street View links accepted; place URLs, non-360 URLs, and arbitrary URLs rejected.
Create/update integration Gray-box code review PASS Both create and update paths call the same thumbnail resolver for Google portfolio type.
Thumbnail expiry mitigation White-box code review PASS Refresh route has a dry_run=true mode; writes and cache invalidation are skipped in dry-run.

API evidence

Request Copyable request/payload Observed response
Health GET http://192.168.1.194:3008/health 200 OK; Redis, RabbitMQ, and all reported databases were up.
Non-mutating refresh GET http://192.168.1.194:3008/v1/cron/refresh-google-thumbnails?dry_run=true SSE: start {"dry_run":true,"total":184}; valid panorama rows emitted fresh public thumbnail URLs. No database update was requested.
Public thumbnail availability GET https://maps.app.goo.gl/MmgYE7HyewJWbQ9f8 followed by its derived public thumbnail 200 OK, Content-Type: image/*. Five independent public short-link samples passed.
Place-only negative data https://maps.app.goo.gl/uUvMvFnqGWwSx4Bv9 Expected resolver result: no panorama id in google maps url. No sensitive payload or credential was used.

Test matrix

Test design Applicable? Coverage
Black-box Yes Public short-link resolution, image HTTP status/content type, API health, non-mutating refresh stream, and invalid place-only link.
Gray-box Yes Runtime responses correlated with routing, refresh behavior, and portfolio integration.
White-box Yes Helper branches, validation rules, create/update resolver wiring, and dry-run write guard.
Confusion matrix Not applicable This feature does not classify predictions against ground-truth classes; pass/fail contract tests are the meaningful metric.

Code review

File/area Review result
Google Maps helper Resolves short links, extracts panorama IDs, uses a public URL path for official imagery and a refreshed public URL for user photospheres. Errors are returned for links with no panorama segment.
Portfolio resolver Uses the new resolver before legacy fallback; create and update share this path.
Refresh endpoint Provides SSE progress; dry_run=true avoids DB writes and cache clearing.
Automated coverage Targeted live and portfolio/helper test suites passed.

Notes

  • No sensitive payload, credentials, or private customer data is included above.
  • The dry-run request exceeded the client time limit before its final aggregate event because it processes all 184 rows serially. It had already demonstrated both valid thumbnail generation and expected place-link skips; this is an observability/runtime-duration limitation, not a confirmed coding defect in the requested thumbnail behavior.
